interpretation: XXS decode improves by about 5.4% versus mx on both added workloads; XS decode is near parity, with a roughly 0.5% mean lead that does not establish a robust speed advantage. Prefill improves substantially in all four cells. These separate-phase screens do not establish server latency, released-file correctness or merge readiness.
